title: Ukulima ngenjongo yentengiso noluntu
description: Ukugcina iirekhodi, ukuthengisa isivuno esigqithileyo nokwakha uthungelwano lokutya lasekuhlaleni.

lessons.title: Ukugcina iirekhodi: ukwazi ukuba ifama yakho ivelisa ntoni ngokwenene
lessons.body:
Isivuno sinokondla indlu, sithengiswe, sabelwane ngaso, okanye silahleke.

Ukurekhoda ezi ndlela zahlukeneyo zokusetyenziswa kukunceda ubone ukuba ifama ivelisa ntoni nokuba yintoni efika kubathengi.

Sebenzisa loo lwazi ukukhusela ukutya kwendlu nokwenza izigqibo zorhwebo ezingcono.

Bhala phantsi sonke isivuno njengoko senzeka.

Rekhoda ii-kg zotamatisi, iidazini zamaqanda, nemixulu yemifino (morogo), uze uqaphele ukuba nganye iye phi.

Sebenzisa isiko elilula elifanayo kukutya okugcinwe ekhaya, kwemveliso ethengisiweyo, kweyaphiwe abanye, nekwenziwe umgquba.

Musa ukuthembela kwinkumbulo ekupheleni kwexesha lonyaka.

Iirekhodi zexesha elinye lonyaka ziphendula imibuzo esebenzayo.

Zeziphi izityalo ezinika isivuno esingcono kwibhedi nganye? Zeziphi ezibuyisa okuninzi kwiyure nganye yomsebenzi?

Zeziphi izityalo ezisebenzisa imbewu, amanzi nomgquba ongaphezulu kunokuba zibuyisa?

Irekhodi likwabonisa ukuba zeziphi iinyanga eziyishiya indlu ithenga ukutya.

Phambi kokumisa ixabiso, rekhoda iindleko zemveliso, zokupakisha nezokuthengisa, kuquka umsebenzi nothutho.

Nanku umzekelo wokufundisa, ayingoxabiso lemarike: utamatisi uyabiza iR18 ngekhilogram nganye kodwa uthengiswa ngeR15 ngekhilogram nganye. Eli xabiso alizigubungeli iindleko ezichaziweyo.

Phonononga ixabiso, iindleko nokutyala okulandelayo. Jonga ukuba abathengi baza kuthenga ntoni ngokwenene; ixabiso eliphezulu lokucela asisiqinisekiso sentengiso.

Sebenzisa irekhodi lakho ukufumana ixesha apho ukutya kwendlu kuphela khona.

Khetha izityalo ezifanelekileyo apho uhlala khona, uze usebenze umva usuka kwisivuno oyidingayo. Jonga iimeko zokutyala nexesha elilindelekileyo lokuvuna.

Umhla osebenza kwenye ifama usenokungasebenzi apha. Quka isicwangciso sasemva xa imvula, amanzi okanye izityalo zisilela.
keyPoints: Rekhoda ubuninzi bezivuno neendawo eziya kuzo ngokwahlukileyo kwimali
Quka iindleko zemveliso nezentengiso xa uvavanya ixabiso
Phawula imizekelo yokufundisa; sebenzisa iindleko zakho zenene ekwenzeni izigqibo
Cwangcisa izikhewu zokutya usebenzisa iimeko zasekuhlaleni zokukhula nexesha lokuvuna

quiz.q: Kulo mzekelo wokufundisa, utamatisi uthengiswa ngeR15/kg yaye iindleko zokuwuvelisa ziyiR18/kg. Umfama kufuneka aphonononge ntoni?
options: Qhubeka uthengisa ngeR15 — ilahleko yexeshana yakha ubudlelwane
Yeka ukulima utamatisi ngokupheleleyo
Ixabiso lokuthengisa, iindleko, nokuba ingaba esinye isityalo asinakubuyisa ngcono na
Faka isicelo sesibonelelo sokugubungela umahluko
quiz.rationale: Ixabiso lomzekelo liphantsi kunendleko echaziweyo. Phonononga umahluko nemfuno yabathengi phambi kokwenza isigqibo esilandelayo semveliso.

quiz.q: Iirekhodi zomfama zibonisa ukuba uswele imifuno rhoqo ngoJuni noJulayi. Lisiphi inyathelo eliluncedo apha?
options: Thenga imifuno emarikeni rhoqo ngoJuni noJulayi
Sebenza umva usuka kwisikhewu sokutya usebenzisa izityalo ezifanelekileyo zasekuhlaleni nexesha lazo lokuvuna
Yamkela ukuba ifama yakhe ayinakuvelisa ebusika
Iirekhodi zibonisa ingxaki yokuchuma komhlaba
quiz.rationale: Iirekhodi zichonga isikhewu. Ukukhethwa kwezityalo nemihla yokuhlwayela kufuneka ke kuhambelane nemozulu yasekuhlaleni, amanzi nexesha elilindelekileyo lokuvuna.

lessons.infographicAlt: Umntu ubambe ipensile phezu kwegridi yerekhodi engenanto kwincwadi evuliweyo, ecaleni kwebhaskithi nemifuno ekhululekileyo.

lessons.title: Ukuthengisa isivuno esigqithileyo: apho uthengisa khona nendlela yokumisa ixabiso
lessons.body:
Buza ukuba umthengi ufuna ntoni: imveliso, ubuninzi, umgangatho, ukuhanjiswa nomhla wentlawulo.

Thelekisa iifizi zemarike, uthutho, ukupakisha neemveliso ezingathengiswanga kunye nexabiso lokuthengisa.

Jonga imithetho yemarike kunye neemfuno zasekuhlaleni zorhwebo nezokutya. Isitali esingekho sesikweni asiyonto ngokuzenzekelayo engenamithetho okanye iindleko.

Ukuthengisa ngqo kunokugcina inxalenye enkulu yexabiso lentengiso, kodwa kuthatha ixesha, ukupakisha, uthutho nokukhathalela abathengi.

Inkqubo yeebhokisi (box scheme) ibonelela ngokhetho oluqhelekileyo lweemveliso rhoqo kubathengi abavumelaneyo.

Vumelanani ngezinto eziya ebhokisini, ixabiso, intlawulo nento eyenzekayo xa izityalo zinqabile. Iiodolo eziqhelekileyo zinceda ukucwangcisa kuphela xa abathengi nabalimi bengakwazi ukugcina isivumelwano.

Qala kwinto onokuyibonelela ngokuthembekileyo nakwinto abayifunayo abathengi.

Jonga iindleko nezidingo zokutya kwendlu phambi kokuthembisa iibhokisi eziqhelekileyo.

Ubungakanani begadi okanye inani labathengi kuphela alikuxeleli ingeniso. Zama ulungiselelo onokululawula uze urekhode iziphumo.

Ukuba imveliso iyatshintsha evekini ngeveki, phepha ukuthembisa ukuhanjiswa okungatshintshiyo ongenako ukukubonelela.

Nikela ngesivuno esigqithileyo onaso uze uvumelane ngemiqathango ecacileyo nabathengi.

Chaza iindlela zakho zokulima ngokunyanisekileyo. Jonga nasiphi na isatifikethi okanye isibango abasifunayo abathengi phambi kokusebenzisa ileyibhile.
keyPoints: Vumelanani ngemveliso, ubuninzi, umgangatho, ukuhanjiswa nentlawulo
Thelekisa iindleko neelahleko kunye nexabiso lokuthengisa
Thembisa iibhokisi eziqhelekileyo kuphela xa ukubonelela nemiqathango yabathengi kuzixhasa
Jonga imithetho yemarike uze uchaze iindlela zokulima ngokunyanisekileyo

quiz.q: Umfama omncinci unemveliso engalinganiyo evekini nevekini — isivuno esigqithileyo kwamanye amaveki, okuncinci kwamanye. Yeyiphi indlela yokuthengisa emfaneleyo kakhulu?
options: Isitali semarike esisesikweni esifuna ukubonelelwa okuhambelanayo veki nganye
Inkqubo yeebhokisi efuna imveliso efanayo veki nganye
Imarike engekho sesikweni okanye ukuthengisela abamelwane ngaphandle kwesibophelelo esimiselweyo
Isivumelwano sesikolo sokuhanjiswa imihla ngemihla
quiz.rationale: Le yeyona ndlela engamfuni athembise isixa esimiselweyo veki nganye — uthengisa le anayo ngokwenene.

quiz.q: Ziyanceda njani iiodolo eziqhelekileyo ezivunyiweyo umlimi ukuba acwangcise?
options: Abathengi beebhokisi bahlala bahlawula okuninzi ngekhilogram nganye
Iinkqubo zeebhokisi zikuvumela ukuba utshaje ngaphezulu ngokupakisha
Ingeniso eqinisekisiweyo yesabhoskripshini ikuvumela ukuba ucwangcise imveliso ngokweemfuno zenene endaweni yokulima ngokuqikelela
Iinkqubo zeebhokisi ziphepha izibophelelo zerhafu
quiz.rationale: Iiodolo eziqinisekisiweyo zinika ulwazi ngemfuno. Ukubaluleka kwazo kusaxhomekeke ekubonelelweni okuthembekileyo, kwintlawulo nakwiindleko zokuzalisekisa.

lessons.infographicAlt: Iindlela ezintathu zokuthengisa kwifama enye: isitali sasecaleni kwendlela, ukuhanjiswa kweqela evenkileni, nebhokisi eya ngqo kwindlu.

lessons.title: Ukwakha uthungelwano lokutya loluntu: amandla akubuninzi
lessons.body:
Abamelwane banokwabelana ngeentlobo ezahlukeneyo nangomsebenzi wokugcina imbewu.

Rekhoda isityalo, uhlobo, umthombo nomhla wokuqokelelwa. Cwangcisa ukwahlula (ukugcina izityalo zahlukene) okufanelekileyo, ukukhetha, ukomisa nokugcina kwisityalo ngasinye.

Ukwabelana akwandisi ngokuzenzekelayo ukwahluka okanye akuphuculi umgangatho. Qinisekisa ukuba imbewu yintoni ngokwenene nokuba iyahluma na phambi kokuthembela kwimbewu eyabelwanayo. Phambi kokutshintshisana ngembewu, jonga ukuba ngaba uhlobo lukhuselwe na nokuba imvume iyadingeka na.

Ukwabelana ngezixhobo kwenza izixhobo ezibizayo zifikeleleke eqeleni.

Impompo yamanzi okanye umshini wokugaya iinkozo usenokungafikeleleki kwibhajethi yendlu enye.

Ukusetyenziswa ngokwabelana kusasaza ixabiso eqeleni kuze kunceda ifama nganye yenze umsebenzi eyayinokungawenza yodwa.

Phatha isivuno ngobunono uze ugcine umthunzi, ukupakisha nokugcinwa okufanelekileyo kude kugqitywe ukuhanjiswa.

Umthengi okufutshane usenokunciphisa uhambo, kodwa iilahleko neendleko zokuthengisa zisafuna ukulinganiswa.

Thelekisa imali efunyenweyo emva kweefizi, uthutho nokonakala kwindlela nganye. Musa ukuthatha ukuba umthengi okufutshane ngowona unika inzuzo engcono rhoqo.

Abamelwane banokubonisa izakhono eziluncedo baze bathelekise okwenzeka kumafama abo.

Rekhoda indlela, iimeko nesiphumo ukuze abanye bagwebe ukuba ingaba ingafanela umhlaba wabo.

Funa ingcebiso evela kwabaqeqeshiweyo xa kukho isifo esingaqhelekanga okanye iingxaki zobuchwephesha. Amava abelwanayo noncedo lwabachwephesha zinokusebenza kunye.
keyPoints: Rekhoda ubuni, umthombo nomgangatho wembewu, ujonge nokuba imvume iyadingeka na phambi kokwabelana
Vumelanani ngoxanduva lokukhathala, lokubhukisha nolokulungisa izixhobo ezabelwanayo
Linganisa iilahleko nenzuzo ecocekileyo kwindlela nganye yokuthengisa
Hlanganisa amava abelwanayo noncedo oluvela kwabaqeqeshiweyo xa kufuneka

quiz.q: Abamelwane bafuna ukwabelana ngembewu egciniweyo. Yintoni enceda ukwenza imbewu eyabelwanayo ibe luncedo?
options: Xuba zonke iintlobo ngaphandle kweelebhile
Vumelanani ngokuhlolwa komgangatho wembewu uze ujonge nokuba imvume iyadingeka na ukwabelana ngohlobo
Cinga ukuba ukwabelana kuphucula ngokuzenzekelayo yonke imbewu
Thembela kuphela kubungakanani beqela
quiz.rationale: Umgangatho wembewu uxhomekeke ekwahluleni, ekukhetheni, ekulebhileni, ekugcineni nasekuhlolweni kokuhluma okuthile kwisityalo ngasinye. Ezo zihlolo aziqinisekisi imvume yokutshintshisana ngohlobo olukhuselweyo; jonga amalungelo asebenzayo phambi kokwabelana.

quiz.q: Umlimi uthelekisa imarike esekude nabathengi abakufutshane. Yintoni emele ikhokele isigqibo?
options: Khetha rhoqo ixabiso eliphezulu elibhengezwayo
Khetha rhoqo uhambo olufutshane
Thelekisa imali efunyenweyo emva kweefizi, uthutho, iimveliso ezingathengiswanga neelahleko
Cinga ukuba ukujoyina iqela kususa zonke iindleko
quiz.rationale: Umgama uchaphazela iindleko, kodwa asilo kuphela isizathu. Sebenzisa inzuzo neelahleko zenene ukuthelekisa ukhetho.

lessons.infographicAlt: Iibhedi ezintlanu ezincinci ezityaliweyo kunye neentolo ezalatha kwibhokisi esembindini yemveliso; itrowula yesandla nejari yembewu zikuyo ngezantsi.
